slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers 54-country review, an AI-assisted compilation by its author, states that rural primary schools in Madagascar predominantly keep attendance, administrative data and learning outcomes in paper registers, with no point-of-service digital tool in rural areas; no date is given for the statement, so the document's published date is used.

systems.platform: data warehouse with SDMX standards, from the PAPESI project
systems.tiers: annual school census questionnaires (levels 1-3 for public schools), said to be likely completed by hand at schools and aggregated centrally

systems.system: solar-powered tablets for teaching content (Solar United Madagascar, SEED projects 2024-2026)
